prompt:
Study the attached completed Krios basketball shot poses. Draw the SAME character, the red-skinned male giant with enormous curled black ram horns, heavy dark charcoal beard, hulking red arms, black Scoria Rams uniform with orange/gold trim and black boots. Do not substitute a long-haired man, a human without horns, or a different team. Keep these defining traits on all six figures.

Six full-body Krios chest-pass frames in a strict 3-column × 2-row grid. True transparent background only, no glow, no gradient, no background, floor, court, hoop, prop, words or other player. Do not draw a ball; game draws a separate ball. Each complete pose isolated with visible spacing. Clean outlined JAMVERSE '96 arcade sprite art.

0 wide stance hands down; 1 hands rise and gather invisible pass at chest; 2 elbows point forward as he aims; 3 both empty hands thrust forward for pass release; 4 arms extended in follow-through; 5 hands return and he recovers to stance. Six different continuous poses; retain Krios's curved horns, dark beard, huge muscular bright-red body, and ember-trimmed dark uniform in every frame.

rejectedGenerations.reason: Changed Krios to a light-skinned long-haired human without horns or beard; only five poses appeared.

historicalSourceAvailability: Original 42-pose input and cleaned sheet referenced by krios-locomotion42-final-provenance.json are unavailable in current workspace; compiled Krios atlases and captain crop were used as identity references.
ballPolicy: Krios-specific separate basketball follows the ball-miming body motion and releases/grabs on the reviewed event frame. Never paint a ball into the poses. Track length: 6.

cleanup.method: alpha-connected component isolation and nearest-pixel reassignment
